body: I found an axe and seed bag wrapped in checkpoint tape. The tag shows one location crossed out, another written over it. Tape edges say something about relocating citizens and files.
title: axe and seed bag

body: The deer came from a pasture that had been sprayed yesterday. Its mouth was wet with a bitter smell, and its legs shook. The driver said the creek near the rows smelled the same.
